name: Shammai
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Shammai is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles who belongs to the tribe of Judah. He appears in the genealogies and is known as the son of Onam and brother of Jada. Shammai is also mentioned as the father of Nadab and Abishur, and his lineage continues through several generations in the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Shammai is listed as the son of Onam and brother of Jada in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah through the line of Jerahmeel.

keyEvents.title: The sons of Shammai
keyEvents.description: Shammai's sons Nadab and Abishur are mentioned in the genealogy, showing his descendants in the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Nadab
keyEvents.description: Shammai's son Nadab had sons Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children, but Appaim had a son named Ishi.

keyEvents.title: Abishur's family
keyEvents.description: Shammai's son Abishur married Abihail and had sons Ahban and Molid.

keyEvents.title: Another Shammai in the genealogy
keyEvents.description: Another person named Shammai is also mentioned as the son of Rekem and father of Maon, in another branch of Judah's lineage.
